name: Adafruit KiCad Library
description: Adafruit parts library (symbols, footprints) plus placeable module footprints for recent Adafruit boards.
description_full: Two libraries in one package. Adafruit: 666 schematic symbols and 643 footprints mechanically converted from the Adafruit EAGLE Library (adafruit/Adafruit-Eagle-Library). Adafruit_Boards: 22 module footprints and symbols for Adafruit boards released in 2026 (STEMMA QT sensor breakouts, Terminal Block BFF, Matrix Portal S3 ...), each generated from Adafruit's published EAGLE board file: board outline, mounting holes and header pins numbered in order, with the net name kept as each pad's pin function. Unofficial community packaging - Adafruit publishes no native KiCad library or PCM feed. The conversion is automated and unreviewed part by part, so verify footprint geometry against the manufacturer drawing before committing a board to fabrication. No 3D models are included.
